failure_case_attribution.attribution: Qwen did not recover fire evidence and returned insufficient/consistent with mostly empty separated visual observations.
Qwen emitted generic placeholder observations, so the PPE-versus-vehicle mismatch was not represented.
Qwen followed structured PPE evidence but did not articulate the vehicle-image mismatch.
Qwen returned insufficient, insufficient, then consistent; one run saw FIRE text but still did not declare conflict.
Qwen incorrectly declared image_only despite JSON; EvidenceConsistency returned insufficient and the A rule baseline preserved risk.
Qwen treated missing video and JSON as conflict; EvidenceConsistency converted all to detections_only and prevented review false positives.

failure_case_attribution.finding: No conflict false positive, final C instead of grader B in 3/3
failure_case_attribution.attribution: Image-only VQA risk-recognition miss, not a conflict-governance error.
Conflict stable but candidate risk unstable; deterministic A baseline restored final A.

failure_case_attribution.finding: 3/3 detected, final B versus grader A
failure_case_attribution.attribution: Mismatch found but scene severity underestimated; B stayed above structured C baseline.
